rec.name: PDP Global Bullet Points (Metaobject-Driven USP List)

what.text: A short bulleted USP list shown in the PDP buy box, between the title and the price/CTA. It is defined once globally, not per product. The content lives in a Shopify metaobject (rich-text field) and is rendered by a 'bullet points' block in the product template. In the example the list has four items: A/B-tested Shopify section; built by experienced Shopify Plus devs; integrates into any Shopify theme; integration in under 5 minutes with no code changes.

why.text: Short, scannable benefit bullets near the title and CTA state the core value proposition at the moment of decision, which reduces uncertainty without extra reading. Mentioning proven results (A/B-tested) and expertise (Plus devs) adds credibility. Ease-of-integration claims lower perceived effort and risk. Defining the bullets globally keeps messaging consistent across all products.

how.text: 1) Create a metaobject definition with a rich-text 'Bulletpoints' field and add one entry (status Active) containing the global USP list. 2) Add a 'bullet points' block to the product page template, below the title and above the price. 3) Connect the block to the metaobject entry (dynamic source). The block help text also mentions the metafield custom.bulletpoints, so per-product bullets are possible but not used here. 4) Adjust text color and opacity in the block settings. 5) If the bullets do not show, re-link the metaobject to the block; this fixed the display issue in the ticket.

items: Metaobject entry (dynamic source) for the bullet content
Rich-text bullet list edited in the metaobject (bold, italic, links, bulleted/numbered lists)
Optional custom SVG check icon field (help text: 'please add svg check icon')

dependencies.text: Shopify metaobject definition with a rich-text field and an active entry, connected to the block in the theme editor. A theme block that accepts a metaobject or the metafield custom.bulletpoints (the Impact theme in the screenshots). Optional: an SVG check icon.

items: Scroll depth / interaction below the buy box

images.caption: Theme editor: the 'bullet points' block in the product template, linked to the Bulletpoints metaobject, with text color and opacity settings.
Metaobject entry 'Bulletpoints' with a rich-text bullet list of four USPs, status Active.
Storefront preview: the bullet list shown under the title and above the price and add-to-cart button.
